title: How to Compare Small Concrete Pumps from China Suppliers
seoTitle: Compare Small Concrete Pumps from China Suppliers | Pinjin
description: A factory checklist for comparing small concrete pumps from China: motor or diesel kW, theoretical m³/h, outlet pressure, aggregate, pipe DN, envelope and weight. Pinjin examples use published Xingtai rows. Marketplace listing prices and copy vary — we do not copy Alibaba text.

answerBlock.what: Compare small concrete pumps from China on the same cells: power (kW), theoretical output (m³/h), outlet pressure, max aggregate, pipe DN, conveying distance, hopper, envelope and weight. Pinjin’s compact electric examples: Electric 15 (15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 450 kg), Electric 20 (22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, 900 kg), Electric 30 (30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 1200 kg). Marketplace listing prices vary by supplier, configuration, MOQ and shipping terms. This site has no published list price.
answerBlock.who: Importers and contractors shortlisting China trailer pumps who want a specification checklist instead of a copied marketplace paragraph.
factors: Identical units: kW, m³/h, MPa, stone, DN, metres, kg
Whether output is labelled theoretical
Factory location and whether boom pumps or plants are actually listed
Quote terms: EXW vs listing price, MOQ, spare-part policy

faqs.question: Should I rank suppliers by the Alibaba price first?
faqs.answer: No. Marketplace listing prices vary by supplier, configuration, MOQ and shipping terms. Pinjin product pages do not publish a list price. Compare specification cells, then ask for a factory quote.

faqs.question: Does a higher number in the model name mean a larger pump?
faqs.answer: Not by itself. Electric 20 and Electric 15 both list 8–10 m³/h. Electric 10 Series lists 21 m³/h theoretical with 25 m horizontal. Compare the table, not the name — see Electric 20 vs 30.
